groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO points did students most frequently make about their musical background before starting a music degree?

options.t: They could play more than one instrument.

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO points did students most frequently make about music practice?

options.t: They try to practise every day.
They are motivated to practise by fear
They feel they don't do enough practice.
They enjoy the challenge of a difficult piece.

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO points were most frequently made by students about the pieces they select for assessed performances?

options.t: They like to hear others performing the same pieces.
They like to choose little-known pieces.
They like to play pieces from memory.
They like their tutor to choose their pieces.
They like to choose technically demanding pieces.

groups.instruction: Which comment did most students make about each of the following aspects of performance? Choose FOUR answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-G, next to questions 27-30. Student comments

questions.text: Performing with musicians from a different genre
Performing with musicians who play the same instrument
